The total number of boys who got admission from places J and M in 2017 was exactly equal to the total number of girls who got admission from place M in which of the following years?
solution:
**Given:**

Total number of boys from places J and M in 2017 = Boys from J (2017) + Boys from M (2017)

Boys from J in 2017 = 10 thousand

Boys from M in 2017 = 8 thousand

Total number of boys in 2017 from J and M = 10 + 8 = 18 thousand

Girls from M in 2016 = 9 thousand

Girls from M in 2017 = 7 thousand

Girls from M in 2018 = 4 thousand

Girls from M in 2019 = 11 thousand

Girls from M in 2020 = 12 thousand

Girls from M in 2021 = 18 thousand

**∴ The year is 2021 when the total number of girls from M is 18 thousand.**
